title: alert.hot_wallet_low
description: The hot wallet's native balance fell below the operating minimum. Every withdrawal is paid out of it, so this is the warning before payouts start failing rather than a report that they have. Edge-triggered: emitted on the way down and not again until the balance has come back above the line, so that a wallet left low does not produce an alert every few minutes.

asset.description: The chain's native coin, which is what gas and this threshold are denominated in.
